_notes: Requirements use real OSRS skill levels. Entries marked verify:true still need checking against the OSRS Wiki. Set bonuses and 'text' effects without code are planned, not yet implemented. Consumables have no requirement: 'potency' is the Cooking/Herblore level that makes them 'perfect' (+15%); items under level 20 have none. Ammo (arrows, darts, knives) never needs Fletching or Runecraft. Potions boost their OSRS skill ('skill_boost': flat + pct of the base level). 'artisan' is the level to make an item yourself, which waives its combat requirements. Items build up League style: 'tier': 'resource' items (Materials tab) and base items feed 'builds_from', and owned parts anywhere down the recipe lower the price. Every pair of boots builds from leather boots. A status's data.style ('melee'/'ranged') limits it to that combat style.
